the use of Fe3O4-Tryptophan-M magnetic nanocatalyst in the synthesis of sulfoxydes and disulfides in the ultrasonic conditions has been reported for the first time.
the Fe3O4/Tryptophan-M catalysts are new catalysts for synthesis of sulfoxide and disulfide.
the Fe3O4 @ Tryptophan-M catalysts were used for the first time for synthesis of sulfoxide and disulfides and the results showed the high catalytic activity of the catalysts.

the use of inorganic–organic nanomaterials as new catalysts in the synthesis of sulfinic acids and disulfides and also the effect of ultrasound on the synthesis of these compounds.
the synthesis of sulfoxydes and disulfides by the use of new magnetic catalysts.
the development of a new class of inorganic–organic hybrids as catalysts for the preparation of sulfoxides.

these magnetic nanoparticles are efficient and reusable catalysts for the oxidation of thioethers.
the use of these magnetic catalysts is a very promising method in organic synthesis.
these catalysts are efficient, easy to use and environmentally benign.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of ultrasound in the synthesis of suloxides and disulfide compounds has many advantages, including reducing reaction time, increasing product yield, and reducing the use of organic solvents.
these magnetic nanocatalyst can be applied for the synthesis of various sulfoxides and di-sulfides in the presence of ultrasound and without it, with a good yield and high catalytic activity.

the Fe3O4-Tryp-M nanocomposites are promising and efficient catalysts for the preparation of sulfoxides under mild reaction conditions.
the Fe3O4 @ tryptophan-M catalysts are very efficient and reusable in the synthesis of suloxides and disulfide.
